URL: https://uk.finance.yahoo.com/news/bank-set-hold-interest-rates-080053859.html
(Search snippet + WebFetch content — Yahoo Finance / PA reporting language, 28 July 2026)
BoE decision Thursday 30 July 2026. Expected to HOLD Bank Rate at 3.75% (level since December 2025).
MPC vote: economists predict 7-2 in favour of hold (Oxford Economics, Nomura). Last meeting 18 June was also 7-2 hold.
Inflation: eased to 15-month low of 2.6% in June (falling food & fuel). Bank had forecast inflation rising to ~3.25% later in 2026 on energy costs.
Decision lands alongside new quarterly Monetary Policy Report — could move sterling sharply either way.
Thomas Pugh, Chief Economist at RSM UK: "If they remain close to 100 dollars per barrel over the summer, a September rate hike would move firmly onto the table." (NB: Brent has since fallen to ~$84.)
Governor Andrew Bailey expected to address geopolitical/oil impact on inflation projections.

Reuters poll (via HomeOwners Alliance / secondary): ~65 economists; majority see 3.75% held through rest of 2026, but nearly 40% predict at least one HIKE by year-end; only six expected a quarter-point cut. As of 22 July markets priced two hikes by March 2027.
Sources: https://hoa.org.uk/news/interest-rate-predictions-2/ ; https://www.propertywire.com/news/bank-of-england-expected-to-hold-rates-at-3-75-thursday/
